title: Total Cost of Tokens
description: Per-user and per-model token and spend insights from APIM custom metrics.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(45d)
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])
| extend Model = coalesce(tostring(Properties["SelectedModel"]), tostring(Properties["Model"]))
| extend SyntheticDay = tostring(Properties["SyntheticDay"])
| extend EffectiveTime = iff(isnotempty(SyntheticDay), todatetime(SyntheticDay), TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where $__contains(SubscriptionId, $developerKey)
| where $__contains(Model, $modelFilter)
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(Sum) by Day = startofday(EffectiveTime), Model
| evaluate pivot(Model, sum(TotalTokens))
| order by Day asc

let ModelPricing = datatable(Model:string, InputPricePer1MUsd:real, CachedInputPricePer1MUsd:real, OutputPricePer1MUsd:real)
[
    "gpt-5.4", 2.50, 0.25, 15.00,
    "gpt-5.4-mini", 0.75, 0.075, 4.50,
    "gpt-5.4-nano", 0.20, 0.025, 1.25
];
let TokenMetrics = AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(45d)
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cached Prompt Tokens", "Cached Tokens")
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])
| extend Model = coalesce(tostring(Properties["SelectedModel"]), tostring(Properties["Model"]))
| extend SyntheticDay = tostring(Properties["SyntheticDay"])
| extend EffectiveTime = iff(isnotempty(SyntheticDay), todatetime(SyntheticDay), TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where $__contains(SubscriptionId, $developerKey)
| where $__contains(Model, $modelFilter)
| summarize PromptTokens = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Tokens"), CompletionTokens = sumif(Sum, Name == "Completion Tokens"), CachedInputTokens = sumif(Sum, Name in ("Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cached Prompt Tokens", "Cached Tokens")) by Day = startofday(EffectiveTime), Model;
TokenMetrics
| join kind=leftouter ModelPricing on Model
| extend UncachedInputTokens = max_of(PromptTokens - CachedInputTokens, 0.0)
| summarize TotalCostUsd = round(sum((UncachedInputTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(InputPricePer1MUsd, 0.0) + (CachedInputTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(CachedInputPricePer1MUsd, 0.0) + (CompletionTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(OutputPricePer1MUsd, 0.0)), 4) by Day
| order by Day asc

AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(45d)
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])
| extend RequestedModel = tostring(Properties["RequestedModel"])
| extend SelectedModel = coalesce(tostring(Properties["SelectedModel"]), tostring(Properties["Model"]))
| where $__contains(SubscriptionId, $developerKey)
| where tolower(RequestedModel) == "router"
| where isnotempty(SelectedModel)
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(Sum) by SelectedModel
| order by TotalTokens desc

panels.title: Total Tokens by Model and Reasoning Effort

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(45d)
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])
| extend Model = coalesce(tostring(Properties["SelectedModel"]), tostring(Properties["Model"]))
| extend ReasoningEffort = tostring(Properties["ReasoningEffort"])
| extend ReasoningEffort = iif(isempty(ReasoningEffort), "unspecified", tolower(ReasoningEffort))
| where $__contains(SubscriptionId, $developerKey)
| where $__contains(Model, $modelFilter)
| where isnotempty(Model)
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(Sum) by Slice = strcat(Model, " | ", ReasoningEffort)
| order by TotalTokens desc
